theorems.name: Submission.lower_density_ge_one_ae_of_radonConverges
theorems.statement: MonotonicityFormula → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → (∀ i, (Vi i).HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation) → (∀ W, IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → liminf (fun i ↦ variationMeasure (Vi i) W) atTop ≠ ∞) → (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ U \ B i, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n (Vi i).weight y θ ∧ 1 ≤ θ) → (∀ W, IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → Tendsto (fun i ↦ (Vi i).weight (B i ∩ W)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ liminf (densityRatio n V.weight y) (𝓝[>] 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
